dimensions.explanation: Selected control concerns material investment changes after authorisation for the specifically defined UCITS population. Operator changes and notifications are separate measures.
UCITS population is expressly defined. Materiality, novelty, complexity and possible local policy implications require judgment; the packet supplies no operational thresholds.

The exception attaches to removal of prior approval. Novelty, complexity or possible local policy implications each defeat eligibility; home-jurisdiction compliance remains a separate necessary condition.

The measure removes an existing prior-approval requirement for qualifying changes. Excluded cases receive no removal under this limb; determining their actual approval obligation also requires the underlying regime. Post-vetting continues and follow-up action is discretionary.

Use the express 28 November 2025 effective date to give content to immediate effect. The proposed reading treats pre-date applications still unapproved at that date as retained in the existing process. Whether that retention preserves every substantive approval condition remains unresolved.

Relevant FAQs implement the measures, and related forms/checklists are referenced but absent. The two missing dependency identifiers have no supplied substantive content or mapping sufficient to resolve these gaps.

citations.quote: The key streamlined measures cover the following post-authorisation matters:

Removing the SFC’s requirement on prior approval for material changes in investment objectives, policies and restrictions which comply with the fund’s home jurisdiction requirements, except for changes that involve novel or complex product features and/or which may have local policy implications.

1 For this circular, UCITS funds means (i) Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) domiciled in France, Luxembourg, Ireland and the Netherlands, and (ii) collective investment schemes domiciled in the United Kingdom authorised as UK UCITS.
The streamlined measures set out in the relevant FAQs will take effect on 28 November 2025 (Effective Date).

Existing applications received by the SFC before the Effective Date for which no approval or authorisation has been granted will be processed by the SFC in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process.
The SFC will continue to conduct post-vetting of scheme changes (including those not subject to the SFC’s prior approval) and related revised documents filed with the SFC.

readings.distinction: This reading tests eligibility for the selected removal of prior approval. The strongest unresolved alternative concerns pending applications: 'existing ... process' could retain only procedure while permitting the new substantive relaxation. That alternative would change the outcome for an otherwise qualifying pre-date pending application, but the packet does not establish it sufficiently to select a second executable rule. Failure of this eligibility test alone does not prove that approval is legally required.

False means this particular removal is unavailable under this reading; it does not independently establish an approval obligation or non-compliance. Unknown inputs remain unknown.
